name: Why is my toilet clogged and not flushing properly?

mainEntity.name: Why is my toilet clogged and not flushing properly?

acceptedAnswer.text: Toilets can clog for several reasons, commonly due to excessive toilet paper, flushing non-flushable items like wipes or cotton swabs, or a buildup of mineral deposits or debris in the drainpipe. Sometimes, issues within the toilet mechanism itself, like a faulty flapper or low water levels, can also lead to incomplete flushing, making a clog more likely to occur.
acceptedAnswer.description: Common causes include too much toilet paper, flushing non-flushable items, or mineral buildup. Issues with the toilet mechanism can also contribute.
